results.title: ICC World Test Championship race wide open after Bangladesh stun Australia
results.description: The latest ICC World Test Championship (WTC) standings have experienced a significant shake-up following Bangladesh’s sensational victory against table-toppers Australia in Darwin. Delivering one of the most remarkable performances in their Test history, Bangladesh secured a comprehensive nine-wicket triumph over the former world champions, shifting momentum in the ongoing 2025–27 WTC cycle.

results.title: ‘It’s never easy’: Devdutt Padikkal reflects on long wait for India Test comeback
results.description: Devdutt Padikkal made a memorable return to Test cricket, smashing his maiden century in the format during India’s first Test against Sri Lanka in Galle on August 15.

results.title: Ian Bishop Hails Bangladesh's Historic Test Win Over Australia in Darwin
results.description: Ian Bishop calls Bangladesh's 9-wicket Test win over Australia a "momentous achievement," praising Hasan Mahmud and the team's historic performance in Darwin.

results.title: Fatima Sana to lead Pakistan in Women's Asia Cup and Asian Games
results.description: Pakistan announce 15-member squads for Women's Asia Cup and Asian Games, with Fatima Sana as captain. Asia Cup starts Aug 28 in Dubai; Asian Games in Japan from Sept 17.

results.title: 1st Test: Day two's play to commence at 2:35pm after rain subsides in Galle
results.description: Rain clears in Galle, India vs Sri Lanka 1st Test day two to start at 2:35pm. Padikkal unbeaten on 131, India at 288/2.

results.title: Watch Marcel Reed find WR Isaiah Horton for an impressive deep pass
results.description: Texas A&M quarterback Marcel Reed is developing chemistry with Alabama transfer Isaiah Horton, which was on full display during Saturday's scrimmage.
